scope: Re-review of the 6 HOLD Persons remaining after the 74/80 representative_domain correction; explicitly approved 3 assignments, preserve 3 NULL.
limits: Representative historical identity may be drawn from documented tradition but tradition is not independent confirmation of historical events.
Do not fabricate reign terms, offices, military commands, Person activities, or Polity relationships.
The predecessor review is immutable audit evidence; this follow-up supersedes only these three domain HOLD dispositions.

assignments.basis: The Yin Zhou Daji chapter of Lie Nü Zhuan attributes promotion and execution decisions of King Zhou to her preferences. This is a representation of political influence in later tradition, not independent proof of acts or formal office.

Giersz (2025) interprets the Principal Lady of Castillo de Huarmey as a regional leader whose authority legitimized provincial Wari rule. This is a scholarly interpretation of archaeological evidence, not an attested office or term.

Barrancabermeja local heritage account identifies Yarima as a cacica alongside cacique Pipatón who led indigenous resistance. Cacica/leadership represents governance; independent battlefield command is not established. This is local historical tradition, not direct proof of chronology.

holds.reason: Narrative survival and revenge do not establish command, rulership or other canonical representative domain.
Ancestor/founder status alone does not establish personally exercised governance or religious leadership.
Causing or appearing in conflict narratives is insufficient proof of direct military command, independent political rule or other representative role.
